title: UAPI: _pad[4] in crypto2dev_init_op not validated as zero
description: crypto2dev_init_op._pad[4] is documented 'must be zero' in the UAPI header but ioctl_init (src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c) does not check or reject nonzero values. Future ABI extension relying on _pad to signal new semantics will have ambiguous meaning if old callers set those bytes to garbage. Fix: add explicit check and return -EINVAL if any _pad byte is nonzero.
close_reason: Added memchr_inv(_pad) check in ioctl_init; returns -EINVAL if any pad byte is nonzero
